about_the_game:
Story

Imagine a world where the boundaries between reality and video games blur. In Daria, you play as a brilliant young girl in futuristic Morocco who discovers her late father’s invention - a device built to bridge realities. With it, she connects to the worlds of her favorite arcade games, leading to an unlikely friendship with a stranded astronaut from a notoriously difficult and broken game.

Gameplay

Daria is an adventure and puzzle-solving game where you collect fictional retro games, each rendered in pixel art. You can trade items and insights not just with Daria, but between the arcade games themselves, unlocking new paths through inventive cross-game interactions. Inspired by classics like Litil Divil and Duck Tales: A Quest for Gold, it features mini-games, a leveling system, and rich lore.

At the bottom of the screen lies The Chain - a dynamic, interactive map showing your current challenge and the next four. Icons mark puzzles, rewards, or mysterious “?” nodes that could hide traps. Do you take the risk and dive in, or play it safe? Solve puzzles quickly to trigger a Chain Rush, where the chain scrambles to keep up - piling on bigger rewards but forcing you to move blind.

Between challenges, return to your Home Base, where you can upgrade abilities, manage inventory, and prepare for what’s next.

Key Features

  • Challenging Puzzles: Face standalone puzzles that test your logic, intuition, and creativity as you progress through Daria’s journey.

  • Arcade Worlds: Discover and play a growing library of fictional retro games, each with its own style, gameplay, and secrets.

  • Cross-Reality Gameplay: Transfer items from one arcade game to another, or alter storylines entirely to unlock hidden paths and endings.

  • The Chain System: Navigate through branching puzzles with a living, dynamic chain map that teases future challenges while keeping you on your toes.

  • Home Base Hub: Upgrade abilities, manage inventory, receive story messages, and plan strategies in your safe haven between adventures.

short_description: In futuristic Morocco, Daria discovers her late father’s device that bridges realities. Explore and play retro arcade games brought to life, solve puzzles, dodge traps, and carry items between arcade titles to unlock new paths - all while uncovering a friendship that could change everything.
